verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a game engine, since engines can ship in-editor assistants, so this is not a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy shipping any built-in AI assistant or agent for delegating tasks. The pack describes only a code-first Rust engine, and the only AI-adjacent tooling mentioned is nascent third-party community work on the Remote Protocol, which is not a built-in assistant.
